\begin{abstract}
This companion document preserves completed supporting studies, physical
validation details, and reward diagnostics for the main paper. A worked RTL
example and runnable package accompany a completed RF versus SFT comparison.
Historical and
post-primary results retain their original populations and measurement
contracts; they are not pooled with the sealed primary estimate.
\end{abstract}
